turns.text: I need the parcel for SC-2074 sent to a different address. I placed the order with nell.ashcombe@example.com.
SC-2074 has already shipped, so I couldn’t change the delivery address. A colleague will take over to check whether the parcel can still be redirected.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer (nell.ashcombe@example.com) wants to redirect SC-2074. Delivery policy check returned already_shipped, so no change was filed. Please review available options; customer has not supplied the new address.
